summary: This clinical trial tested a combination of three oral drugs, glimepiride, vildagliptin, and metformin, in adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar from food. The study included 162 participants to see how well these combined medicines worked. This Phase 3 trial was sponsored by Laboratorios Silanes S.A. de C.V. and is now completed.
